page_title: MON 1-2 TOU | Monaco v Toulouse 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90+6' PENALTY APPEAL by Toulouse, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
90+4' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) takes the free kick which is dealt with by the opposition defence.
90+3' Guillermo Maripan (Monaco) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
90+2' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+1' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yann Gboho.
88' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
88' The ball is out of play and Toulouse manage to earn a corner.
82' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Bastien and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
82' A goal, which was scored by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco), was disallowed due to offside.
81' Frank Magri (Toulouse) manages a fine header towards goal, but it misses the target as the ball flies past the right post.
80' Toulouse take the free kick with a short pass.
80' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul. Toulouse are awarded the free kick.
78' Substitution. Ismail Jakobs will be replaced by Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco).
76' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Thijs Dallinga and he is replaced by Aron Donnum (Toulouse).
75' Monaco exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
73' Monaco have a corner.

73' What a wasted opportunity by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the top right corner, but Guillaume Restes makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
71' Substitution. Folarin Balogun is replaced by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
70' 1 - 2 Goal! Logan Costa (Toulouse) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:2.
70' The referee awards a corner and Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) goes over to take it.

69' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
69' Monaco keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
68' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
65' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Christian Mawissa Elebi (Toulouse) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

65' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Philipp Kohn makes a great save to stop his effort.
63' Total attempts – 18:9.
61' Christian Mawissa Elebi (Toulouse) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Philipp Kohn has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
58' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the right post.

58' Frank Magri (Toulouse) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Philipp Kohn was alert and the score remained the same.
56' Substitution. Warren Kamanzi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mikkel Desler (Toulouse).
56' CHANCE! Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post.
53' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
52' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
52' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
48' 1 - 1 Goal! Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:1.
48' A cross into the box from Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is cleared.
47' The ball is out of play. Monaco will take a throw-in.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+3' The opposition back off Takumi Minamino (Monaco), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the left side of the goal corner, but Guillaume Restes denies him with the save.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
44' Monaco are seeing far more of the ball now.

41' 0 - 1 Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 0:1.
41' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. That's a free kick to Toulouse.
39' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
35' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
34' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
33' CHANCE! Warren Kamanzi finds Frank Magri (Toulouse) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!
31' Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
30' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) commits a foul and Benoit Bastien immediately signals a free kick.
29' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
29' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
29' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
27' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
26' Frank Magri (Toulouse) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
25' That will be all from Mohamed Camara who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco).
22' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' Monaco quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
21' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
21' Christian Mawissa Elebi (Toulouse) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the top right corner is far too weak and Philipp Kohn makes a simple save.
20' Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
16' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
12' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for an infringement.
10' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom right corner is thwarted by Philipp Kohn.
9' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' The referee blows his whistle as Denis Zakaria (Monaco) was too aggressive in his challenge.
6' Some patient build-up play from Monaco as they look to unlock the defence.
4' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
2' The linesman makes the right call and Toulouse will have a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Toulouse will take the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
